actual_source_reads.support_scope: Supports poor feeding including weaker or shorter sucking and prompt medical assessment at hospital or medical centre; complete feed refusal is not required. Does not reproduce the RCH under-6-month cutoff or prove immediate emergency transport. Queensland professional synthesis acknowledges RCH and other common upstream material; separate writing is not independent underlying evidence.

scope: Targeted closure of remaining source/population findings. No full re-review of unchanged independently accepted claims. Shared sources retain original metadata. This is an author report, not clinical signoff.

targeted_resolutions.S02: Added independent Australian procedure/device risk source; preparation checklist remains practical communication, not efficacy.
targeted_resolutions.S03: Preserved separately attributed RCH and NHS age thresholds; added NICE adult communication and absent-fever assessment. Exact-age limitation remains explicit. Reviewer-requested Queensland poor-feeding action corroboration added; regional and shared-upstream limits retained, no body wording changed.
targeted_resolutions.S04: NLM culture definition and Healthdirect/SSC monitoring; no single-test interpretation is adult SSC and paediatric RCH scoped.
targeted_resolutions.S05: Added NHLBI ECG/troponin support and UKHSA cessation review; source roles separated.
targeted_resolutions.S07: Added IDSA risk-selected antifungal scope and NHS C. difficile; joint clinical evidence overlap acknowledged.
targeted_resolutions.S08: Adult CKD scope explicit; ASN recovery advice has adapted provenance; no claimed independent efficacy proof.
targeted_resolutions.S09: CDC hospital discharge/family guidance; SSC adult cognitive/emotional follow-up.
targeted_resolutions.S10: Removed indexed-only rheumatology generalisation; replaced with directly read ASHP drug-specific advice. Maternal paragraph uses CDC and independently written Australian patient source; not coded as a complete neonatal or puerperal topic.
targeted_resolutions.S12: Removed vague risk-reduction benefit; chronic-care/medication reconciliation and independent catheter advice bound.

regional_evidence_boundaries: RCH specifies under 6 months and hospital; Queensland supports prompt assessment of poor feeding in infants/children without that exact age cutoff, and acknowledges shared RCH background. NHS separately uses under 5 with not feeding. These are attributed conditional regional recommendations, not one universally validated age threshold.
